panels.speaker: Франц
panels.line: Как будто в прошлый раз так же начиналось.
panels.scene: Close head-and-shoulders view in a daylight pine forest. Exhausted adult Franz wakes behind a fern-covered fallen log. His bare shoulders and normal human arms are visible above dense foliage. His right hand alone continues into skin-coloured tentacles at the wrist, his left fingers are elongated. All lower body is obscured by ferns and the log. Same fair-haired moustached face from original issue4, eyes uncovered.
panels.attribution_note: Исходник — реплика игрока; разрешённая адаптация во внутреннюю речь.

panels.caption: По старым чертежам — на дерево.
panels.scene: From behind Franz's bare shoulder, his normal left arm with long fingers reaches toward a nearby pine trunk. He is too weak to pull himself up. Dense ferns obscure his lower body, daylight filters through pines.

panels.speaker: Франц
panels.line: Помогите! Убивают!
panels.scene: Tight painted portrait of Franz's face and bare shoulders as he calls for help. His eyes search the empty forest. No other people or attackers.
panels.attribution_note: Сокращение объявленного крика, не реальный нападающий.

panels.speaker: Франц
panels.line: О, всё легко. Город туда.
panels.scene: Close portrait of Franz, absurdly confident, pointing his normal left index finger toward sunlight through the pine canopy. Foreground ferns hide his torso below the shoulders. Right arm is outside this closeup.
panels.attribution_note: Ведущий озвучивает внутреннюю мысль Франца. Уверенность ошибочная.

panels.caption: Одежда из «хвойной рябины». То есть по-прежнему голый.
panels.scene: Across a fallen log among thick ferns, Franz slowly crawls toward a woodland path. Only his face, bare shoulders and arms emerge from foliage. His left hand braces on the log, and a pale flesh-coloured tentacle-hand extends from his otherwise normal right wrist. No clothing or other figures.
panels.attribution_note: Авторская адаптация шутки ведущего, без фантастического хвойного дерева.

panels.caption: Клаус проснулся в чужой коже — с больным боком.
panels.scene: Daylit shabby room in the port district, with two rough pallets, a shelf and a street-facing wooden door. Klaus in the borrowed female skin of Margot wakes on one pallet clutching a bruised side. Preserve the gaunt wrinkled face, grey-brown wisps and weary thin mouth of the original Klaus portrait. Two normal eyes remain visible below a narrow stained bandage tied across the FOREHEAD above the eyebrows. Wear a loose, shabby burgundy garment and cap. Fully clothed. He is free, not bound. No tentacles, no fair-haired Franz.

panels.speaker: Клаус
panels.line: Я люблю, но не умею.
panels.scene: Klaus as Margot sits by the shelf holding a battered book open in the correct orientation. The haggard face is fascinated but cannot decipher it; one eyebrow is raised with absurd enthusiasm. Keep the same burgundy clothing, gaunt borrowed face and forehead bandage ABOVE the visible eyes. Both hands have ordinary human anatomy, with only a few subtle sucker marks; no tentacles. No readable marks on book pages, no other character.

panels.speaker: Биба
panels.line: О, проснулась наша жемчужина.
panels.scene: Klaus cautiously opens the real street door, which is visibly hinged into the room wall. Outside on the port cobbles exactly two fully dressed adult human toughs, Biba and Boba, simultaneously turn to look at Margot. Establish Biba as broad and bald with a blunt nose and dark brown vest; Boba is leaner with a broken nose, short black beard and dull grey cap. Shabby practical Renaissance clothes. Klaus freezes half behind the door. Not a corridor. All three faces and separate hands legible.

panels.speaker: Клаус
panels.line: Секрет в том, чтобы пить с утра.
panels.scene: At a coarse outdoor table just outside the same room, Klaus as Margot proudly lifts a filthy tin beer mug over a bowl of thin stew and a chunk of bread. His grotesquely confident smile contrasts with the gaunt face and ragged burgundy dress. Biba, broad bald in dark brown vest, and Boba, lean dark short beard with grey cap, sit or stand on the far side watching skeptically. Three adults, six ordinary arms, no tentacles. Warm dirty daylight, port wall behind.

panels.speaker: Клаус
panels.line: У меня есть жалование?
panels.scene: Klaus as Margot looks up in astonished interest from the rough table, one normal hand pointing at his own chest after learning that wages exist. Biba, the broad bald man, gestures toward a large wooden washing barrel nearby, while Boba in his grey cap shrugs. The barrel is filled with water but Klaus remains fully dressed beside it; no bathing nudity. Keep three separate adult bodies and the same faces and clothes established in preceding panels.
panels.attribution_note: Два кратких облачка допустимы: громила — «Помойся хоть. Будешь нашей кормилицей» [343,345].

panels.caption: В таверне спалось куда мягче.
panels.scene: Morning in Godfrey's Gothic timber tavern. Exactly four companions share a breakfast table: adult Jack in worn brown leather coat and burgundy scarf; very short stout adult Pippin in green cloak and ochre bodice; young adult Archivist with tied light-brown hair, round glasses and dark navy fur-trimmed clothes; elderly Doctor Popov with grey curls, beard, round glasses and deep green coat. Bowls, bread and spoons. Jack quietly beckons Pippin away. Godfrey and Thorin are absent from the room. Preserve issue4 faces, no extra lead characters.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Архивариусу пока не рассказываем. Она связана с Инквизицией.
panels.scene: On the stair landing away from the breakfast table, Jack bends his tall torso down to whisper to Pippin, a clearly adult, short stocky halfling with a full freckled face, dense copper curls and rounded ears hidden by hair. Their eyes flick toward the distant table where the Archivist is only a small navy-clad silhouette. Jack conspiratorially cups one hand beside his mouth; Pippin listens with folded arms. Anatomically separate figures, no child proportions.
panels.attribution_note: Пиппин отвечает «Может быть, мы наводяще спросим?» [437] — максимум второе короткое облачко.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Не сейчас? Окей.
panels.scene: Back at the breakfast table, exactly Jack, Pippin, Archivist and Popov. Jack tilts his head and sends Pippin an exaggerated secret sideways glance while holding his spoon. Pippin stares back without understanding, spoon paused above bowl. The Archivist sits stiff and suspicious, Popov looks deliberately away. Faces and eye lines carry the failed silent exchange; no magic beams, no telepathy effects. All four different identities from original references.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Пойду, блядь, над душой у тебя постою.
panels.caption: Джек позвал всех на утреннюю молитву.
panels.scene: At the tavern exit after breakfast, the Archivist in navy fur trim has turned to leave for work. Jack, having secretly excluded her, now extends an open hand in a self-righteous invitation to prayers. She turns her head back with a fierce weary glare, hand on the door frame. Pippin stands near Jack at her much shorter adult height, while elderly Popov waits behind holding his doctor's bag. Exactly four companions, visible grounded doorway.
panels.attribution_note: Джеку коротко «А молиться Сигмару?» [520].

panels.speaker: Доктор Попов
panels.line: Куда интереснее, чем лбом в пол торчать.
panels.scene: Wide morning courtyard beyond the tavern gate. Exactly two broad, muscular adult dwarfs are bare to the waist, fighting EACH OTHER with two enormous double-handed axes. One is Thorin, orange-red mohawk, copper beard and tattooed arms; the other older balding grey-bearded dwarf follows the original Godfrey face but is not named in the image. Both axes held in their own two hands, no extra limbs. At one side elderly Popov stops with delighted clinical interest. In the background Jack, short adult Pippin and the young Archivist take a cautious arc around the fight and head away. Non-graphic clash, no wounds or severed parts. Six characters total, enough space between them.
panels.attribution_note: Имена двух дворфов не печатаются. Рыжий соответствует Торину, второй визуально пожилой серобородый. Нельзя превращать их в двух людей.

panels.speaker: Пиппин
panels.line: Если бы ты могла избавиться от Инквизиции, ты бы это сделала?
panels.scene: Daylit Gothic town street while Jack, Pippin and the Archivist walk toward the temple. Pippin, the very short stout ADULT halfling, draws close to the taller Archivist and leans toward her shoulder to ask quietly. The Archivist looks down at her with a skeptical raised brow, round spectacles catching light. Jack follows one pace behind and watches their conversation. Use original cover for Jack and Pippin and original Archivist portrait for her young face. Three companions only, no Doctor.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Спроси: она сдаст нас Инквизиции при первой возможности?
panels.scene: On the same street Jack leans conspicuously close to Pippin, loudly whispering into a hand and making an enormous knowing wink. The Archivist has clearly heard him and turns her head to look directly at him. Pippin's full freckled adult face tightens with embarrassed disbelief. Keep Pippin much shorter than the two humans, small round ears hidden by copper curls. A clear comic beat, exactly three adults.
panels.attribution_note: Второе короткое облачко Пиппин: «Бля, беспалевно?» [570].

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Ты что-нибудь поняла? Сдаст или нет?
panels.scene: Jack stoops down toward Pippin again, baffled, palm cupped beside his lips. Pippin looks up equally perplexed. The Archivist in navy stands beside them, arms folded, staring with dry amusement at their hopelessly obvious plotting. Keep all three faces in one legible triangular arrangement, hands separate and attached to their own arms. Quiet medieval street, no new props.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Хозяин Марка — тот, кем интересуется Инквизиция. А ты должен её выпроводить?
panels.caption: Пришлось рассказать о ночной сделке.
panels.scene: The three have stepped aside against a real blank stone wall away from passersby. Jack has confessed and spreads his hands in anxious explanation. The young Archivist, round glasses and tied light-brown hair, points a single finger at him while calmly summarizing the dangerous bargain. Pippin listens close beside Jack, green cloak drawn in. Daylight and deep blue shade, exactly these three adults, no Mark flashback figure.
panels.attribution_note: Сокращение смысла. Нужна плашка «Пришлось рассказать о ночной сделке». Не прорисовывать встречу с Марком как новое событие.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Все карты у нас! Выйдем сухими. И при бабках.
panels.scene: Jack stands facing the Archivist and grips her two shoulders with his own two hands, trying urgently to sell his clever solution. His burgundy scarf and broad angular face remain recognizable. Her youthful face behind glasses shows exhausted disbelief; her own hands stay low and free. Pippin stands off to the side nervously watching the street, her adult halfling height below their shoulders. No violence, bruises or romance. Exactly three bodies, six ordinary arms.
panels.attribution_note: Ответ Архивариуса в маленьком облачке: «Мы расходное мясо» [680].

panels.caption: Джек молился с воодушевлением. Остальным мешали мысли.
panels.scene: Inside the candlelit Gothic temple of Sigmar, exactly three companions face the altar: Jack bows fervently, adult short stout Pippin kneels facing the altar, and the young Archivist kneels beside her. Jack is beyond Pippin, not touching her. Cold blue tall windows and golden hammer imagery, no crosses. Pippin and Archivist seem distracted, while Jack is absorbed in prayer. Their backs and three-quarter faces are visible; no Doctor Popov anywhere in temple.

panels.caption: Пиппин ощутила знакомый ком в горле.
panels.scene: Close three-quarter view of adult Pippin kneeling in the temple, green cloak pooled around her small sturdy body. She touches her own throat and lifts her worried freckled face toward a side aisle. Dense copper curls conceal small rounded ears, not elf ears. Beside her the young Archivist bends forward over her prayer, navy fur trim and round glasses recognizable. Clear separate hands, no physical illness effects or vomiting.

panels.caption: Он смотрел не на неё.
panels.scene: Temple side aisle with a clear diagonal sightline. In the near foreground Pippin has turned her head; just beyond her the kneeling Archivist remains bent over. In the distant aisle stands the established inquisitorial man from reference: tall black broad-brimmed hat, dark mustache and pointed dark beard, black-and-red coat with parchment flame badge. His watchful gaze is aimed past Pippin AT THE ARCHIVIST. He is already turning his shoulders to leave through the aisle. No dialogue, no touch, no attack. Three characters, no Doctor or warrior-priest with a hammer.
panels.attribution_note: Инквизитор смотрит мимо Пиппин на Архивариуса. Внешность по прежнему дознавателю из №1, печ.16; точная личная идентификация не подписана. См.refs/inquisitor-provenance.json.

panels.caption: А Франц почти вернулся к людям.
panels.scene: Cut to the sunlit wheat fields outside town. The adult fair-haired mustached Franz slowly brushes the golden grain with his RIGHT flesh-colored tentacle limb in a wistful cinematic gesture. His left human hand has long fingers. Pale upper torso, normal visible eyes, no blindfold, no clothes other than a useless bit of bark at the waist. Thick foreground wheat completely conceals pelvis and buttocks. Distant Gothic town beyond, exactly one main character. His face must follow original Franz portrait, not Jack or Klaus. FRANZ ANATOMY LOCK: the entire RIGHT shoulder, biceps, elbow and forearm are ordinary human flesh, fully present. ONLY the RIGHT HAND is replaced at the WRIST by flesh-colored tentacles. The right arm is not missing. Tentacles start at the visible right wrist and nowhere else. No tentacles emerge from shoulder, chest, elbow or upper arm. LEFT arm and long-fingered left hand remain human.

panels.caption: Осталось придумать, как им показаться.
panels.scene: Franz hides in dense tall corn near the wheat field, visibly pale and exhausted. He holds a partly eaten corn cob in his elongated-fingered LEFT hand; his single mutated RIGHT limb curls up to scratch his scalp and sticks there, creating a ridiculous puzzled pose. Keep limbs connected to their correct shoulders; flesh-colored mutation continuous with his forearm, no blue octopus. Crops fully conceal unclothed lower body. Far away small farm workers and barns are visible, unaware of him; not attacking. No new clothes or healing. FRANZ ANATOMY LOCK: the entire RIGHT shoulder, biceps, elbow and forearm are ordinary human flesh, fully present. ONLY the RIGHT HAND is replaced at the WRIST by flesh-colored tentacles. The right arm is not missing. Tentacles start at the visible right wrist and nowhere else. No tentacles emerge from shoulder, chest, elbow or upper arm. LEFT arm and long-fingered left hand remain human.
panels.attribution_note: Сжато объединены установленные состояния. Не рисовать50 атакующих или добытую одежду.

panels.speaker: Клаус
panels.line: А где перстень?
panels.caption: К обеду Марго приодели.
panels.scene: Daylight near the rich district. Klaus as Margot has washed and been forced into a different shabby WOMAN'S DRESS: dull dusty plum-brown coarse fabric, modest small neckline, sleeves, and crudely shortened uneven skirt above the ankles. Fully clothed with legs visible only below the skirt; ordinary footwear. Preserve the gaunt wrinkled borrowed face and narrow forehead bandage ABOVE two visible normal eyes; hair grey-brown. Looking down in surprise, he searches his bare ordinary fingers for his own missing signet ring. Small suction marks on normal hands, NO tentacles, no Franz. No ring on either hand.
panels.attribution_note: Предшествующее переодевание дать короткой плашкой «К обеду Марго приодели». В кадре нет Джека и его печатки.

panels.caption: Пришлось лезть старым путём.
panels.scene: Klaus as Margot, in the same dusty plum-brown uneven dress and forehead bandage, has just tumbled over a high iron fence into the manor grounds and crouches at its foot, trying to sneak forward. In the far background a small patrol of three armed adult town guards has spotted this conspicuous figure and starts running toward him. Show the fence attached to stone posts and the landing side clearly. All hands human, no tentacles, no knightly armor on Klaus. Daytime chase begins.
panels.attribution_note: Комическая самоуверенность после упоминания страшного вида; можно заменить на авторскую плашку, если фраза без контекста непонятна.

panels.caption: Лаз закопали.
panels.scene: Klaus as Margot bursts out of thorny bushes behind the manor, reaching a wall where a small escape hole USED TO BE. The ground is visibly freshly filled with earth; no open passage remains. He stops and looks down in dismay, knees bent and hands spread. The same ragged short woman's dress, gaunt face and forehead bandage; fully clothed. Approaching patrol silhouettes remain in the background well behind. Keep cause and destination readable.

panels.speaker: Клаус
panels.line: В окно! Его-то ещё не отремонтировали…
panels.scene: Klaus as Margot grabs the sill of a familiar low manor window with two ordinary hands and looks up at a tight row of wooden boards nailed across the entire opening. He is outside the real wall, with no passage available. His disappointed gaunt adult face and bandage ABOVE the eyes are visible in profile. Dusty plum-brown dress and grey-brown hair maintained. Camera from outside at three-quarter angle; no impossible floating door, no success entering.
panels.attribution_note: Реплика может закончиться многоточием перед зрительным опровержением. Дать паузу — без ещё одного длинного текста.

panels.speaker: Охранник
panels.line: Марго!
panels.caption: У самых дверей мир погрузился во мрак.
panels.scene: Wide non-graphic climax of the daytime chase at the manor main entrance. Klaus as Margot, in the same woman's dress, has nearly reached exactly TWO stationary manor guards in the doorway ahead. A pursuing patrolman BEHIND him catches him with a sword stroke across the back; show a torn cloth slit and a very small dark blood stain, no open flesh. Klaus pitches forward losing consciousness. The two door guards recognize him and reach toward him in shock; they did NOT strike him. Main door built into wall, clear direction of flight from left rear toward right front. Exactly four prominent figures: Klaus, pursuing attacker, and two door guards; other patrolmen can remain off-frame. Both arms remain normal, no tentacles.
panels.attribution_note: Возле падающего героя допустимо коротко «Товар не попорти, сука!» [1065]. Отдельная плашка «Мир погрузился во мрак» [1084]. Это потеря сознания.

panels.caption: Дворфы всё ещё дрались. Ставками никто не интересовался.
panels.scene: Return to the tavern courtyard in daylight. The same TWO bare-chested adult dwarfs still clash with huge two-handed axes: orange mohawk Thorin and older balding grey-bearded opponent. Elderly Doctor Popov has turned away in disappointment, his doctor's bag in hand, after finding no willing bettors. One bored passerby at a distance ignores the routine fight. No crowds or coins changing hands. Non-graphic physical comedy, separate readable axe handles and four dwarf arms.

panels.speaker: Доктор Попов
panels.line: Будешь, обязательно будешь. Вот только скушай.
panels.caption: Джек объявил себя лидером на сегодня.
panels.scene: At the temple steps Jack has just theatrically announced himself today's leader, shoulders back and open hands. Facing him elderly Doctor Popov, original grey curls and beard, round spectacles and green coat, smiles with patronizing patience and holds out a tiny wrapped sweet between his own fingers. Short adult Pippin and young navy-clad Archivist watch beside Jack. Four adults, no children. The sweet is a harmless confection, no spell glow or medical syringe.
panels.attribution_note: Попов: «Будешь, обязательно будешь. Вот только скушай» [1186,1187].

panels.scene: Wide panoramic establishing view along the medieval port at noon. Exactly four companions Jack, short adult Pippin, young Archivist and elderly Popov approach a small port office doorway on the DRY quay. To the right cargo ships sit in water, dockhands carrying loads. To the left rises the immense dark Inquisition sailing ship with tall masts and Gothic timberwork. A splendid enclosed black-and-gold carriage with four pale horses stands firmly on dry cobbles, separate from the water and gangplank. Prioritize clear pier edge, grounded wheels and ship in water; no cart or carriage afloat.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Архивариус, давай быстрее. Мне некомфортно.
panels.scene: Jack stands near the office door looking uneasily upward at the carved figurehead on the distant Inquisition ship. He takes a plain dark hat off his own head in a nervous courteous gesture. The figurehead remains a rigid wooden sculpture, no animated eyes or movement. Beside him the Archivist turns a key in the real office door lock with her own young hand; tied hair and round glasses, navy fur-trimmed outfit. Other companions can be cropped off-frame. Clear harbor depth, cool light.
panels.attribution_note: Не анимировать скульптуру как объективно живую.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Присаживайтесь. Кто где может.
panels.scene: Inside the Archivist's very small wooden port office, exactly four companions squeeze around a plain writing table: Pippin already on a stool, Archivist setting down her papers, Popov standing beside a spare chair. Jack has stepped in last and slides the iron bolt of the CLOSED door from inside with one hand, glancing back at the group. Keep a real wall, hinged door, iron slide and tight room proportions. No Grant, Klaus, Franz, dogs or extra attendees.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: У тебя будет очень важная роль. Ты будешь нам не мешать.
panels.scene: Inside the cramped port office with a plain writing table, closed bolted door, narrow window and paperwork. Jack in worn brown leather and burgundy scarf paces between furniture, delivering an over-important speech to elderly Popov. Popov sits with a dry, unimpressed look. Short stout adult Pippin pulls her knees aside to let Jack pass; the young Archivist watches from the desk. Exactly four established faces, room visibly only a few steps across. No other people.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Доктор, все вопросы потом.
panels.scene: Close view across the office table: Jack has tossed the small plain signet ring given to him by Mark; Doctor Popov catches it in his own open palm and examines the seal through round spectacles. Keep Jack's sleeve brown leather, Popov's sleeve deep green, both hands adult male, fingers anatomically clear. The ring is intact and unique, not the missing ring of Klaus. Blank sheets and quill on table, no printed pamphlets yet.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Они умеют управлять красивыми и умными женщинами.
panels.scene: Jack makes a teasing small curled-hand gesture as though holding an imaginary leash, glancing at the young Archivist. She calmly shoots back a dry retort, chin lifted, round glasses and fur-trimmed navy clothes. Adult Pippin watches with amusement while Popov remains skeptical. Exactly four bodies with individual hands; NO literal leash, collar, dog or animal. Their original drawn faces remain unchanged.
panels.attribution_note: Не добавлять реальный ошейник или поводок.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Берём деньги Марка. Пишем: Инквизиция уходит. А часть её людей остаётся в засаде.
panels.scene: Jack leans over the plain office table and traces an elaborate plan with his index finger on a BLANK sheet, gesturing toward the harbor window. The young Archivist, elderly Popov and short adult Pippin look on without conviction. Keep the plans strictly implied by gestures and blank paper, no readable writing, symbols, arrows or diagram overlays, and do not depict future ships leaving as actual events. Preserve separate hand ownership and the small cramped room.
panels.attribution_note: Сокращение плана, никаких уже исполненных событий.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: А мы уплывём с эльфами.
panels.scene: Jack finishes his pitch with a deep theatrical bow in the tiny office, one arm extended and other hand over chest, expecting applause. Pippin, Archivist and elderly Popov remain absolutely still and silent, looking at him without enthusiasm. Leave a visual pause around their flat expressions. Full adult Pippin proportions despite her short height, young Archivist face, grey-haired bearded Doctor. No applauding hands, no extra ring, same closed office door.
panels.attribution_note: Визуальная пауза для отсутствующих оваций.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Пока нет доказательств, Инквизиции срать на мои слова.
panels.scene: In the small closed port office, the young Archivist sits upright at her desk and slides her open palm across the blank proposed plan, rejecting it. Jack stands opposite, still hopeful but gradually deflating. Her light-brown hair is tied, round glasses sit on nose, navy fur collar framing a youthful drawn face. Keep only these two in the close composition, not extra duplicates of the group.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: А будут доказательства — никакие брошюры не нужны.
panels.scene: The Archivist turns from Jack toward elderly Popov to explain why evidence matters. Popov peers skeptically at the intact signet ring held delicately between thumb and forefinger near the tabletop. Jack is visible at the side, mouth about to interrupt; Pippin may be a small green-cloaked shoulder at the edge. Maintain distinct gazes and four-person room continuity. No magic vision or actual printed pamphlets.
panels.attribution_note: Попов: «Будь я агентом Инквизиции, я бы то же самое сказал» [1324], если помещается.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Хорошо, мы объединились.
panels.caption: Джек потребовал объединиться.
panels.scene: Jack spreads his two arms broadly demanding group unity, nearly touching the walls of the tight office. Facing him the young Archivist gives a weary minimal nod, hands resting on her own lap or table. Pippin sits between them at a lower height, elderly Popov watches from the side. Exactly four adults, no forced handshake or hug; their expressions make the false agreement funny.
panels.attribution_note: Архивариус: «Хорошо, мы объединились» [1336].

panels.speaker: Пиппин
panels.line: Клаус давно с Марком и наместником. Может, у него есть доказательства? Найдём его?
panels.scene: Pippin, a very short stocky ADULT halfling with full freckled face and copper curls, quietly raises her own hand from the corner of the office table to offer the first sensible idea. panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Не забудьте еду и питьё начальнику порта.
panels.scene: Medium-wide junction view of the four separating. Jack and Pippin turn toward the harbor at left; Popov and Archivist turn toward the tavern at right. Archivist looks back over her shoulder to remind them of a promised delivery. No one has food crates or drink barrels yet. All four characters remain countable.

panels.speaker: слуга-полурослик
panels.line: Годфри нет. Может, дня два-три не будет.
panels.scene: Medium interior of the crowded Steel Mountain tavern, Popov and Archivist speak to ONE adult halfling servant carrying an empty tray. Godfrey's place behind the bar is conspicuously empty, Godfrey and Thorin themselves are absent. Dim amber candles and carved worn wooden beams. The servant answers with uncertain shrug; patrons are background adults without extra named companions.
panels.attribution_note: Сокращённая адаптация неопределённого ответа о пропаже хозяина. Поход к оркам не показан как факт.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Ёб твою мать, доктор! Вот это штырит!
panels.scene: Medium view inside the upstairs tavern room. Young adult female Archivist opens a real wooden door at right and stops in startled surprise. At left grey-haired bearded Popov with round glasses is already dancing energetically, fully clothed in an open loose medical robe over shirt and trousers; untidy grey curls and wide excited eyes. A medicine chest is on the floor beside the low couch. No consumption act or instructions, only the comic aftermath.
panels.attribution_note: Действие употребления опущено; виден только результат.

panels.speaker: Попов
panels.line: Нет, не надо смешивать.
panels.scene: Wide inside the same modest upstairs tavern room. Archivist at right offers one intact RED APPLE toward dancing grey-bearded Popov at left. He waves his two hands in an energetic refusal while remaining fully clothed in robe over shirt and trousers. No touching lips, no romance. His round glasses and grey facial hair stay visible.

Medium full-body two-shot. Archivist awkwardly steps in time with Popov, gently steering his wrist while he holds the intact red apple. She tries to raise that wrist toward his mouth, but he dances away instead. Their four arms trace clearly from shoulders, no entanglement. Comic attempt to calm a restless companion, no kiss or sexual posture. Faces retain mature identities.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Только после тебя.
panels.scene: Medium reverse view. Now Popov offers the red apple back to Archivist, its surface lightly pale-dusted with no preparation shown. Archivist leans back and raises one refusing palm. Popov is eager and restless, Archivist wary and sober. No text labels or drug packaging detail.
panels.attribution_note: Никакой схемы приготовления, сексуализации или возрастных шуток.

panels.speaker: Попов
panels.line: Что-то херня. Я иду тусоваться.
panels.scene: Medium two-shot. Popov still holds the offered apple in his outstretched hand near Archivist's mouth. Archivist only PRETENDS to bite, her lips not touching the fruit and her hands empty. Popov notices, becomes bored and turns his shoulders toward the room door, gesturing downstairs with his other arm. The apple stays in Popov's hand throughout. No kiss and no romantic body contact; comic frustration only.

Medium dynamic view of the room door. Archivist has caught the back of Popov's LOOSE GREEN ROBE, but he has slipped out and runs toward the corridor, still completely dressed in opaque shirt and trousers. The EMPTY robe stays in her hands, intact apple in his one hand. The robe is clothing, not shed skin. Door integrated in wall, no extra limbs.
panels.attribution_note: Короткая связующая реплика адаптирована из попытки удержания; можно оставить кадр без слов.

panels.scene: Wide room interior with Archivist alone beside the open medicine chest. Inside are THREE distinct groups of small opaque jars and cloth pouches; unreadable abstract labels only. She studies them with puzzlement, wearing glasses and blue fur-trimmed cloak. Popov is absent. Keep the ordinary shared bedside cabinet separate from the medicine chest.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Для тестов.
panels.scene: Medium detail of Archivist's young adult hands wrapping a few small samples from the medicine chest in THREE separate sheets of plain paper. Three simple paper parcels lie on the table, the full chest remains in the room. No chemical recipe, no readable labels. Her blue cuffs and fur trim connect to her figure.

panels.speaker: Попов
panels.line: Маэстро, дай мне бит!
panels.scene: Medium view of the tavern downstairs. Energetic grey-bearded Popov in shirt and trousers, WITHOUT robe and WITHOUT outer cloak yet, leans toward the ONE adult halfling fiddler seated in a corner holding a violin and bow. Popov asks for livelier music with two impatient open hands. Apple held or pocketed plausibly, no extra figure mistaken for a dwarf. Dim candles, bored patrons.

panels.speaker: скрипач
panels.line: Я только вот это учил.
panels.scene: Close two-shot: the timid adult halfling fiddler with violin and bow gives an apologetic shrug, while Popov at the edge looks disappointed by the quiet music. No musical notation or lettering. The fiddler's bow is held in a normal hand, no strings merging with Popov.

Quiet medium shot upstairs: Archivist alone has now tucked all THREE small paper parcels into the inner lining of her open fur-trimmed cloak. One last parcel is just disappearing into the inner pocket, the other two create subtle separate folds beneath the fabric. She gives the medicine chest a thoughtful glance. Popov does NOT return in this panel; she remains alone.
panels.attribution_note: Заменён повтор возвращения доктора: Архивариус остаётся одна, прячет три образца. Возвращение Попова только на122.

panels.speaker: Пиппин
panels.line: Не переживай. Я всегда буду с тобой.
panels.caption: Тем временем в порту.
panels.scene: Wide view of a port street in the same evening/night timeline, visibly switching to the parallel story. Only Jack and much shorter adult Pippin walk toward the damaged port office. She notices his worried glance and gently reassures him. No Archivist or Popov present. Leave a quiet top-left strip of sky for a later caption.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Даже искать не пришлось.
panels.scene: Medium low-angle inside the port office. A BROKEN wooden door slab has been pushed aside, leaning against its original wall beside the exposed door opening. On the floor lies ONE simple signet ring. Jack bends to pick it up with one hand while Pippin waits beside him, her adult halfling stature clear. The detached door does not close the opening and has no functioning lock. The ring belongs to Mark, not Klaus.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Думал, объединимся и свернём горы. А с ними каши не сварим.
panels.scene: Medium-wide interior: the signet is already IN JACK'S COAT POCKET, not on the table. Jack sits in Archivist's EMPTY wooden chair and puts both boots on the desk in imitation of the earlier inquisitor, looking discouraged. Pippin stands beside the desk, shorter but adult. Archivist herself is absent. Worn office papers face the desk user and have no legible text.

panels.speaker: Пиппин
panels.line: Каждый думает о своём выживании. Просто мы заботимся друг о друге.
panels.scene: Close two-shot from desk height. Pippin calmly answers from beside the desk, round freckled face thoughtful; Jack listens from his chair, expression tired. Her face is adult with dense copper curls, not a little girl. Only these two visible characters. Candlelight and cool night window.

panels.speaker: Джек
panels.line: Раз уже ночь, Грант остался голодным. Идём к Годфри.
panels.scene: Medium-wide view of Jack and Pippin leaving the port office and returning toward the inland city under a dark night sky. Jack makes a resigned empty-hand gesture about their unfulfilled delivery; Pippin follows. They carry no food crates, no beer barrel and have not drunk yet. The broken door slab stays behind at the office wall.
panels.attribution_note: Адаптация мета-спора в решение героев. Не показывать выпитое или доставленную еду.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Хотела понять, чем тебе утром помочь.
panels.scene: Wide view from the upstairs room doorway: grey-bearded Popov has RETURNED FOR HIS OUTER CLOAK and catches Archivist looking into their shared bedside cabinet. She straightens and explains herself. The medicine chest remains separate, the three paper parcels hidden in her cloak lining. She now holds the red apple he has handed to her. He is fastening his deep green outer cloak over opaque shirt and trousers; grey curls and round glasses preserved. Real door in wall.

Medium two-shot in the same room. Archivist has put the apple safely on the bedside cabinet and approaches Popov with a spread opaque blanket between her two hands, trying to settle him. Popov is already alert beside the doorway, feet braced to slip away, outer cloak on. No violence, no romantic staging. The cabinet and open exit are separate readable objects.
panels.attribution_note: Положение яблока после передачи Архивариусу не сказано. Для непрерывности она кладёт его на тумбочку, чтобы освободить руки для одеяла.

panels.scene: Medium dynamic shot: the blanket falls empty between Archivist's hands as Popov dodges around its edge and slips through the real doorway into the corridor. He remains fully clothed in his green outer cloak, shirt and trousers. Archivist stays inside near the cabinet. Apple remains on cabinet. No doubled character or extra limb.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Кажется, у меня что-то болит. Не могли бы вы меня осмотреть?
panels.scene: Medium view down the wooden tavern corridor. Archivist stands at the upstairs room door and calls after Popov, one hand lightly at her side as though claiming a pain. Popov runs away toward the staircase, looking forward and refusing to stop. This is a short comic failed pretext to regain his attention, not a medical emergency. Distinct direction of movement and sightlines.

panels.speaker: Попов
panels.line: Show must go on!
panels.scene: Wide tavern hall view: Popov has improvised a DRUM KIT from ONE UPSIDE-DOWN WOODEN CHAIR, plates, cups, and spoons. He happily strikes the dishes with one spoon in each hand. The chair legs and plates are physically connected and legible. Grey beard and glasses, green outer cloak over clothing. Adult patrons watch with puzzled annoyance; no professional drum kit, no snow indoors or outdoors.

panels.speaker: Архивариус
panels.line: Когда выдохнется — уложите в кровать. Утром воды.
panels.scene: Wide tavern view with young adult Archivist in foreground giving a small handful of copper coins to ONE adult halfling servant. She points discreetly toward grey-bearded Popov in background who is still happily clattering spoons on the improvised chair-and-dishes drum kit. This is an arrangement to put him to bed LATER; he is NOT asleep yet. Keep hands distinct and coin transfer visible.

Medium Archivist at the inn exit, straightening her blue fur-trimmed cloak over her modest dark blue dress, smoothing her loose light-brown hair. Her round spectacles remain on. The THREE small paper parcels are inside her cloak, no loose supplies in her hands. Worn fur trim and mature young-adult face, calm tired sigh. Popov remains offscreen behind her.

Medium-wide night exterior of the tavern. Archivist draws her hood over her loose hair and walks ON FOOT toward the port over DRY COBBLESTONES. In the background two adult halfling stable workers carry hay toward Jack's ordinary working CART and its one harnessed HORSE standing on land by the inn; horse is in front of cart and shafts connect correctly. No aristocratic carriage, no vehicle in water, no falling snow or rain. Focus on Archivist leaving.
panels.attribution_note: В исходнике игрок Архивариуса называет транспорт каретой; по принятому сюжету это рабочая телега Джека. Спорный транспорт можно оставить небольшим фоном.

panels.scene: Medium-wide deep blue night street: hooded Archivist walking toward the harbor from left meets Jack and much shorter adult Pippin coming back FROM the harbor at right. Exactly these three named characters. They slow to face one another beneath a lantern. No arrival at a ship, no scaffold, no new character joining.

Quiet final medium three-shot on the same night street. Young adult Archivist at left has both hands tucked into the opposite sleeves of her fur-trimmed cloak like a muff, hood up and glasses visible. Jack and short adult Pippin have stopped opposite her, tired and expectant. Their gazes meet. No one starts a new plan or gestures to an unseen destination. Warm lantern pools in cold blue city shadows.
panels.attribution_note: Это реальный конец действия, а не анонс разыгранной следующей сцены.
